query:
INSERT INTO machines (
            available,
            name,
            poweroff_name,
            arch,
            sel4_plat,
            isa,
            soc,
            cpu,
            cores,
            ram,
            max_clk,
            num_files,
            linux_num_files,
            pxe_linux,
            dtb
        ) VALUES
        (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        RETURNING id
